sanskrit: yas tvārāyaḥ praviveśa- -ajānir janivām̐ uta | atho yas tanvaṃ pasparśa tam ito nir ṇayāmasi ||
english: Whatever demon (arāya) has entered you — the one who knows not a wife, and the one who does know women — and whatever has touched your body, him we drive out from here.

sanskrit: niṣ ṭvārāya nayāmasi ya imāṃ praviveśitha | ātmānam asyā mā hiṃsīr anyatra cara meha bhūḥ ||
english: We lead you, O arāya, out — you who have entered her. Do not harm her person; go elsewhere, be not here.

sanskrit: yad arāyemām upāyasi dhehy asyai rayipoṣaṇam | prajāṃ cid asyā mā hiṃsīr anyatra cara meha bhūḥ ||
english: When you, O arāya, approach her, bestow upon her the nourishment of wealth. Yet do not harm her offspring; go elsewhere, be not here.

sanskrit: yad arāyehāyasi hanāma vīrudhā tvā | atho khanitrimais tvā- -ād vṛṣeṇa yathābhagam ||
english: When you, O arāya, come here, we smite you with the herb. And also with the dug-up roots we strike you with the potent one, each according to his share.

sanskrit: yad arāyāsūyaṃ straiṣūyam āvatokyam | yat paitṛṣadyaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ tad ito nir ṇayāmasi ||
english: That which comes from envy, that which belongs to women's sorcery, that which pertains to difficult childbirth, whatever ill-fortune derives from the seat of the fathers — all that we drive out from here.

sanskrit: yat te sūrya divi deveṣu varcas tasya no dhehi tvam asi pracetāḥ | ahaṃ tvad ugras tviṣitas tviṣīmān imāṃ vācaṃ vi sākṣīya ||
english: Whatever brilliance (varcas) you have, O Sūrya, in heaven among the gods — bestow that upon us; you are the all-knowing (pracetās). I, fierce and blazing with your fire, filled with splendor, may I make this utterance manifest.

sanskrit: vātaḥ purastāt pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
english: The cloud-bearing wind (nabhasvān Vāta) purifies from the east. Homage to you; we know your name — do not harm us.

sanskrit: tapojā amūro dakṣiṇataḥ pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
english: Born of heat (tapojā), the unwavering one (amūra), the cloud-bearing wind purifies from the south. Homage to you; we know your name — do not harm us.

sanskrit: viśvāyur viśvajanīnaḥ pratīcyā diśaḥ pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
english: The all-life-giving (viśvāyur), born-of-all-people (viśvajanīna), the cloud-bearing wind purifies from the western quarter. Homage to you; we know your name — do not harm us.

sanskrit: śivo vaiśvadeva udīcyā diśaḥ pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
english: The auspicious one (śiva), belonging to all the gods (vaiśvadeva), the cloud-bearing wind purifies from the northern quarter. Homage to you; we know your name — do not harm us.

sanskrit: atiṣṭhāvān bārhaspatya ūrdhvāyā diśaḥ pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
english: The supremely standing one (atiṣṭhāvān), belonging to Bṛhaspati (bārhaspatya), the cloud-bearing wind purifies from the upward quarter (zenith). Homage to you; we know your name — do not harm us.
